scope: Contribution of this selected SPL package to the current three reporting modules; not a whole-Primer gap claim.

requirements.supported_scope: Native source T1 and T2 weighted whole-head volumes can be inspected.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: No FLAIR, DWI/ADC, susceptibility or postcontrast series; no automatic hippocampal-long-axis reformats or complete HARNESS examination.

requirements.requirement: Bilateral hippocampi: size, signal, architecture, orientation
requirements.supported_scope: Two gross source hippocampal labels with matching source T1/T2 background and physical orientation.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: No independently validated boundaries, normal ranges/asymmetry, sclerosis, CA/DG/subiculum/SRLM classes or complete internal architecture truth.

requirements.supported_scope: Both source-labelled fornices and mammillary bodies are displayed; source discrepancy/outlier is explicitly inspectable.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: Fine tract calibre/continuity, attachment/termination, nuclear subdivisions and clinical atrophy assessment are unvalidated; processed and label surfaces differ.

requirements.supported_scope: Unlabelled whole-head MRI background offers general context only.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: No dysplasia, heterotopia, transmantle abnormality or complete cortical/sulcal/grey-white-junction annotated coverage.

requirements.requirement: Other substrates, dual pathology and skull base
requirements.missing_or_unverified: No tumour, vascular malformation, gliosis, encephalomalacia or encephalocele disease examples/validated lesion extent; no full-pathology search validation.

requirements.supported_scope: None from this atlas source case.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: No peri-ictal timeline, EEG/semiology, lesion causality, diffusion or enhancement interpretation.

requirements.supported_scope: Bilateral source hippocampi, amygdalae and parahippocampal parcels can be related to coronal T1/T2 context.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: Clinical boundary validation and standardised scoring plane selection remain unverified.

requirements.supported_scope: Gross source anatomy is available as a non-normative reference.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: No age-calibrated atrophy/normal distribution, MTA scale examples, validated volumetry or longitudinal comparison; no separate selected temporal-horn/choroid-fissure models.

requirements.supported_scope: Whole-head MRI background, one publisher-described healthy subject.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: No disease spectrum, posterior-parietal/precuneus labels among the twelve, age context or comparative volume-loss assessment.
No Fazekas, lacunar/strategic infarct, microbleed or siderosis evidence; FLAIR and susceptibility absent.
No validated mass/collection/hydrocephalus example or DWI/ADC study.

requirements.requirement: Selected limbic labels and gross relationships
requirements.supported_scope: All twelve producer identities are coherent with source metadata and plausible gross source MRI locations; no demonstrated side swap.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: All fine boundaries, fibre/nuclear subdivisions and independent clinical accuracy remain unproved.

requirements.supported_scope: Unlabelled background MRI can supply general context; other Primer sources are outside this package review.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: Most gyri/sulci, central-sulcus relation and complete subcortical/deep-white-matter models.

requirements.supported_scope: Unlabelled background MRI can supply general context; other Primer sources are outside this package review.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: Basal ganglia, thalamic nuclei, internal-capsule limbs and corpus-callosum subdivisions are not among the selected twelve.

requirements.supported_scope: Unlabelled background MRI can supply general context; other Primer sources are outside this package review.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: Brainstem levels, cerebellar lobules/peduncles and fourth-ventricle models.

requirements.supported_scope: Unlabelled background MRI can supply general context; other Primer sources are outside this package review.
requirements.missing_or_unverified: Complete compartment models and validated midline/lesion measurements.

requirements.supported_scope: Unlabelled background MRI can supply general context; other Primer sources are outside this package review.
